goal_source: Owner decision, 2026-11-24: flat monthly subscriptions that give a lot of value are welcome; pay-per-token is not (Git Crafter rules/compute.md, Money). The $49 is Code Security and Secret Protection for one committer on one private repo, recorded in compute.spend_exceptions. Near adds one more committer's Secret Protection ($19, github.com/security/plans).

The host sets the ceiling: GitHub Pages sends Strict-Transport-Security and none of the other three on the live page (HEAD read 2026-11-25). Its docs list no way to set a response header (docs.github.com, GitHub Pages limits, read 2026-11-25), and the request for one is open on GitHub's community board (github.com/orgs/community/discussions/199121, found 2026-11-25). The template goal, 4 of 4 (OWASP Secure Headers Project), returns when the page is served by a host that sets headers: delete goal, near and this source then.
